answer_1.quote: We aim to develop a QAG system to generate high-quality QA-pairs, emulating how a teacher or parent would ask children when reading stories to them.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the generated QA-pairs in terms of similarity by Rouge-L precision score with different thresholds on candidate QA-pair amounts...

answer_4.quote: We recruited five human participants (N = 5) to conduct a human evaluation to evaluate further our model generated QA quality against the groundtruth and the baseline...
answer_4.guideline: evaluated based on syntactic correctness, semantic correctness, and relevance
